energy_accounting.study_energy_disclosure: Built-in Apple chip counters per worker process; no wall power meter attached.

claims.statement: Computers often swap data in text formats written for human eyes, forcing machines to spend extra energy reading them back.
Reading indented configuration text took over two thousand times more chip energy per record than reading compact machine numbers directly.
Chopping text into AI word pieces burned twelve times more chip energy than parsing the text, before any model ran.
Headline outcome: Up to 2,054x Extra Chip Energy Reading Human Text (Built-in Apple chip counters per worker process; no wall power meter attached.)

easy_read.easy_title: Machine Numbers Save Power Over Human Text
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about machine numbers save power over human text.
Computers often swap data in text formats written for human eyes, forcing machines to spend extra energy reading them back.
Reading indented configuration text took over two thousand times more chip energy per record than reading compact machine numbers directly.
Chopping text into AI word pieces burned twelve times more chip energy than parsing the text, before any model ran.
Key result: Up to 2,054x Extra Chip Energy Reading Human Text.
Built-in computer chip counters recorded the energy used.
